about_the_game:
A true historical experience!

Dive into the rich tapestry of Medieval Europe with our historically grounded Micro-Multiplayer Online Game! Unlike typical fantasy realms, our game immerses you in an authentic medieval setting where you'll embark on a journey through the intricacies of life in this era.

Features:

*Point & Click Mechanic: Navigate seamlessly through the world with our intuitive point-and-click interface.

*Historical Accuracy: Experience a meticulously crafted world that stays true to the historical context of Medieval Europe.

*Open World Exploration: Roam freely through vast landscapes teeming with adventure and opportunity.

*Diverse Skill System: Master various skills including Woodcutting, Fishing, Cooking, Crafting, Melee, Chivalry, Ranged, and more.

*Micro-Multiplayer Servers: Interact with up to 50 players per server, creating a dynamic and engaging community.

*Thrilling Challenges: Confront wild animals, traverse dense forests, rise through the ranks as a knight, and vie for glory in epic battles.

*Community Engagement: Assist villagers, earn their respect, and reap the rewards in the form of coins and recognition.

*Economic Empowerment: Shape the in-game economy by crafting your own equipment, trading goods, and driving commerce.

*Quests Galore: Embark on exciting quests that will test your skills, courage, and wit.

*Expansive Future: Stay tuned for regular updates and new content additions, promising endless adventures on the horizon.

Experience the ultimate cross-play journey on Android, PC, and iOS platforms, anytime, anywhere. Whether you're a seasoned adventurer or a newcomer to the medieval realm, join us and carve your own path through history!

name: Mist Of Time

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core™ i3-6100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core™ i5-12500H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Embark on a thrilling, historically accurate medieval adventure in this point-and-click MMORPG! Enjoy a simple yet addicting experience with an old-school vibe, rich content, and realistic gameplay. Dive into a unique world where casual clicking leads to endless discoveries, battles, and rewards!
